objective: Compose the canonical CRM created-at cohort with the reusable multi-dimension acquisition snapshot so River OS can produce bounded weekly, monthly, or explicit calendar-window economics without moving population semantics into insurance analytics.
rules: The CRM persistence layer remains the sole owner of timestamp validation, date-window validation, ordering, and limit enforcement.
Insurance analytics does not duplicate created_at SQL.
Omitting limit preserves the canonical CRM default of 50.
Returned relationship IDs are canonically validated before snapshot execution.
The snapshot application is invoked exactly once per request.
All requested aggregate dimensions operate over one reusable attributed economics view load.
No cohort, snapshot, view, or aggregate result is persisted.
explicitlyDeferred: pagination beyond the bounded first page
